post.summary: Registry scan → Commit Status write-back (legacy Harbor entry)
post.description: Post-build callback: writes the scan conclusion (types without scanning skip it) and the Git commit status (harbor-scan context); tag omitted = the first tag in the registry's tag list (most recently pushed for Harbor; order not defined for registry:2, so supply tag explicitly). New integrations should use registry-sync

Base write-back endpoint: verifies the tag, writes ci_pipeline_artifacts, records the audit row and writes the Git commit status (registry-sync context). ci_pipeline_artifacts is written only when ci_status=success (failed/running must not produce a deployable artifact, so a pushed-but-failed pipeline can never be projected as a successful push); the audit row (ci_security_checks) is written for every ci_status - writeback_status=success (push fact) / skipped (failed, running: audit only); the Git commit status write-back is unaffected. Registries without scanning produce no scan conclusion and report scan_state=unknown

post.summary: Custom Push CI build result single report
post.description: custom_push only: report the terminal build result (success/failed/aborted). status=success requires tag and writes ci_pipeline_artifacts; other non-control fields are stored in variables_json

A missing project (or a project without repositories) returns 500 + message; a registry with /v2/_catalog disabled reports an explicit error instead of an empty array.

get.summary: Tags of a repository (auto pagination, up to 2000)
get.description: Dispatches by the global registry type: Harbor uses its tags API (most recently pushed first); registry:2 reads /v2/{name}/tags/list and follows the Link header (order decided by the registry). repository is the short name with the project prefix stripped; when it contains / (e.g. a/b for mycode/a/b) it must be double-encoded as %252F. A missing repository returns 500 + message. A registry without url configured returns 409.

409.description: Image registry is not configured (missing url)
